description: Look up what changed in ABAP Cloud, CDS, ABAP SQL, RAP, EML, ABAP Unit, ATC and the development tools across the 2502 to 2608 release trains plus ABAP Platform 2025 (SAP_BASIS 816), from a dated knowledge base bundled with this package. Each row carries an original summary, an optional syntax sketch, the release and ABAP release, the products it was verified for, the cited SAP source URL, and a confidence flag ("confirmed" = fact-checked, "reported" = single-source). Use this when you are about to write or review ABAP and need to know whether a language, CDS or RAP feature exists in the target release — for example before using CDS table entities as draft persistence, BUFFER ON, RAP change documents, global side effects, or a feature-control attribute. Filter by sinceRelease to see only what is new since the customer's current level. Rows flagged pre-2502 exist to stop an agent presenting an established feature (business events, late numbering, prechecks, bgPF) as a 2025-26 novelty. It does not connect to any SAP system, does not read release notes live, and is not a complete changelog — it is a curated snapshot (curated 2026-09-10) and the target system's own release notes stay authoritative. For released-API state of a specific object use check_released_api; for Clean Core levels and ATC vocabulary use search_sap_knowledge. Example: explain_abap_release({ "sinceRelease": "2605", "kind": "rap" }).

kind.description: Restrict to one facet: "language", "cds", "sql", "rap", "testing", "atc", "tooling" or "eml". Use it to answer "what is new in RAP" without wading through tooling rows.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return, 1 to 200; defaults to 60. Raise it only when you really want a full release dump.

product.description: Restrict to one product: "btp" (SAP BTP ABAP environment), "s4hc-public", "s4hc-private" or "onprem". Rows list the products their source actually verified.

sinceRelease.description: Return only rows at this release or newer, chronologically: pre-2502, 2502, 2505, 2508, platform-2025, 2511, 2602, 2605, 2608. Use the customer's current level, e.g. "2508", to see what upgrading buys them.

topic.description: Free-text topic matched against row ids, titles, keywords and summaries, e.g. "draft table entity", "side effects", "change documents". Omit it to browse a whole release or facet.

name: explain_abap_release

curatedDate.description: Date the bundled knowledge base was curated.

deltas.description: Matching release-delta rows, newest release first.

abapRelease.description: ABAP language release, e.g. "9.19" for the 2605 cloud train or "8.16" for ABAP Platform 2025.

confidence.description: "confirmed" = independently fact-checked against the source; "reported" = single-source or search-snippet only.

id.description: Stable row id, also its resource id under abap-mcp://knowledge/release/.

keywords.description: Search terms this row answers to.

kind.description: Facet: language, cds, sql, rap, testing, atc, tooling or eml.

minRelease.description: Lowest release that supports the feature, when the source stated one.

products.description: Products this row was verified for.

release.description: Release the change belongs to, or platform-2025 / pre-2502.

sourceKind.description: Which kind of SAP source the URL points at.

sourceUrl.description: The cited SAP source this summary was written from.

summary.description: Original abap-mcp summary of the change, never SAP's own wording.

supersedes.description: Objects or artifacts this change replaces or deprecates, when named.

syntaxSketch.description: Short illustrative ABAP or CDS snippet written for this entry; a shape hint, not drop-in code.

matchCount.description: How many rows matched before the limit was applied.

scopeNote.description: Dated-knowledge caveat to repeat to the user.

truncated.description: True when more rows matched than were returned.

title: Explain ABAP Cloud / RAP release deltas
